description: Declarative resource provisioning. Checks current resources on target address and purchases only what is missing. Auth required.

bandwidth_minimum.description: Minimum bandwidth the address should have.

duration_sec.description: Rental duration in seconds on the fixed market grid, from 2 minutes through 24 hours (default: 3600).

energy_minimum.description: Minimum energy the address should have.

idempotency_key.description: Unique operation ID (1–200 characters). Reuse exactly this ID when retrying this operation.

target_address.description: TRON address to provision resources for.

name: ensure_resources
